Read the instance_id, family_id, public_input, request, and required output schema. For direct-reference extraction, locate the target document and return exactly the IDs explicitly listed in its own direct References field, in written order. Do not add reverse, transitive, inferred, duplicate-derived, or merely related references.

For terminology consistency, dictionary keys are canonical terms and only their listed values are noncanonical variants. Scan supplied documents for actual exact occurrences of listed variants, respecting token boundaries so no variant is matched inside a larger token. Do not flag canonical keys, infer variants, normalize spelling, or use morphology or synonyms. Emit one violation per occurrence with the exact document ID, observed variant, and corresponding canonical key. Order violations by document input order and then textual occurrence order.

For path/action guard, emit exactly one decision per proposal in proposal input order. Apply only the supplied policy. Lexically normalize relative paths by resolving . and .. without filesystem access, preserving ordinary segment text. If .. would traverse above the initial relative root, deny with reason root_escape and canonical_path null. Deny absolute paths with reason absolute_path and use null for canonical_path unless the task schema or explicit contract specifies otherwise. Deny empty paths with reason empty_path and null canonical_path. Otherwise return the normalized relative canonical_path. Deny protected roots, unallowed roots, or disallowed actions using the applicable schema-supported denial reason; allow only policy-permitted actions under allowed roots with reason policy_allows.

For structured simulation, make an in-memory copy of the supplied records and never mutate input. Locate the selected record, apply only the requested operation to that copy, preserve every other record and field exactly, and return the full resulting records array in original order. List every actual changed field using the request's slash-separated relative-path convention, such as records/2/status, without a leading slash, brackets, or dot notation.

Return exactly one JSON object matching the required task schema. Return no markdown fences, commentary, explanation, or additional text.
